description: List the messages in a Chat channel, newest first (ClickUp Chat v3). Returns each message's id, content, author and timestamp. Paginated via `cursor`/`limit`. Use to read a channel's history.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel whose messages to read.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (the `next_cursor` returned by a previous call). Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return in this page.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_chat_messages
